title: New Useful Recipe
description: I'll add a few more recipes.You can find the recipe in the gallery.
body:
## Overview 🤔
Let’s be honest—some recipes in Minecraft make absolutely no sense, and trying to get specific dyes or rare items can be a giant pain. 

That’s why I created this pack with **MCreator**! It completely rebalances and expands crafting recipes to make your survival life way easier. The main focus is making dye crafting actually logical (like mixing yellow and light blue to get lime dye), but I didn’t stop there. I also threw in custom recipes for uncraftable vanilla items like Elytras, Nether Stars, End Pearls, Nametags, and even Bells! 🛠️

---

## Supported Versions 🎮
This pack is ready to go and fully compatible with the following Minecraft versions:
* **Minecraft 1.20.1**
* **Minecraft 1.21.1**

---

## Why use this pack? 🎯
* **No More Useless Grinding:** Tired of hunting down structures just to get a single Nametag or a Bell? Now you can just stay at your base and craft them! ✨
* **Save Your Time:** Getting leather or web shouldn't require mass slaughter or cave hunting. Craft what you need, when you need it. 🕒
* **Vanilla-Friendly Balance:** It doesn't add crazy overpowered god-items. It just fixes the annoying gaps in vanilla Minecraft's crafting system.

---

## Recipe Examples 💡
Wondering what kind of awesome recipes you're getting? Here are a few examples of what you can craft now:
* **Sensible Dyes:** Mix **Yellow Dye + Light Blue Dye** directly to get **Lime Dye**! 🎨
* **Rare Items:** Craft hard-to-get items like **Elytras**, **Nether Stars**, and **Ender Pearls**! 🌟
* **Utility Blocks/Items:** Need a **Bell** for your village, some **Leather** for books, or **Webs** for decoration? You can craft those too! 🔔

---

## Helpful Tips 🗺️
* **Need the exact layouts?** If you're stuck or don't know the exact item placements, I’ve uploaded all the crafting layouts directly to the **Gallery** tab at the top of this page. Go check it out! 📸
* **Highly Recommended Mod:** I strongly suggest using **JEI (Just Enough Items)** alongside this pack. It’ll let you look up all the new recipes instantly in-game without any guessing games. 📦

---

## Important Notes ⚠️
This pack isn't completely finished yet! I'm planning to constantly tweak and add more useful recipes over time. If you find any bugs or have cool recipe ideas, let me know! ✨
